decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Cover Letter, ICNIRP Public Exposure Guidelines declaration, Developer's Notice, 'General Background Information' document, 'Supplementary Information' document, 'Mobile Connectivity' (5G Information) document, and drawings 100(Rev.A), 200(Rev.B), 300(Rev.B), 400(Rev.B) and 400(A)(Rev.A) [received 06/10/2020]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The new section of safety railings to be installed shall be painted black to match the existing railings at the site, and the three cabinets shall be formed of light grey steel (RAL 7035), in accordance with the application documents hereby approved.
